description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. S. P. A. Weerawardana as a member of the Na-ula Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Naula Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party, which falls under election-related matters.
